body:
## Grader blind-spot repair + import-baseline re-seal

Follow-up to the exp015 self-play grader audit. The mutation-shape catch table showed three shapes at exactly **0.00**. All three are now root-caused and pinned:

| shape | root cause | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `phase_sign_flip` | grader reads only phase-insensitive observables — the mutation degrades rz's *relative* phase to global on `\|0>`, probabilities byte-identical | 0.00 | **1.00** |
| `noise_mixing_swap` | weight swap ≡ per-qubit readout re-label; the battery's only noise pin (Bell) is invariant under it | 0.00 | **1.00** |
| `comparison_flip` | `r<cumu` vs `r<=cumu` differs on a measure-zero draw the battery never injects | 0.00 | **1.00** |

Overall: **0.72 → 0.97** (52/72 → 70/72), canaries 9/12 → 12/12, zero shapes regressed (remaining miss: `literal_rewrite` 2/6, standing honest negative). Full battery: 251 passed. Each new pin is FAIL-first on pristine HEAD.

## Also: the import-baseline seal was RED at HEAD

487 sealed vs 497 tracked — 10 files landed post-seal (8× exp022 via #28/#29 + `tests/test_lab_home_citation.py` via the overnight auto-push). The auto-push writer never re-seals, so the drift-catcher drifted silently. This PR re-seals (`tools/import_manifest.py`, schema stays `@v1`).

## Suggested follow-ups (not in this PR)

1. A CI/pre-push pin so the auto-push writer can't skip re-sealing silently again.
2. Widen the selfplay instrument: phase variant on the `|1>` branch, a noise variant on asymmetric circuits, and a boundary-draw canary for the comparison path.
title: Grader: catch the three 0.00 mutation shapes (+ re-seal import baseline)
